update.title: Connected local Ollama models to ComfyUI
update.summary: Added ComfyUI nodes for querying local Ollama models, passing chat history between graph steps, and listing the models available on a configured endpoint.

blocks.body:
## Call a local model from the graph

I added Ollama Query to send a prompt and optional system prompt to a local Ollama server from inside ComfyUI. The node exposed sampling, context, reproducibility, and connection settings directly in the graph, then returned the response text, raw JSON, and token count for downstream use.

blocks.description: Captures show the original Ollama Query controls and the separate node used to list models from the configured endpoint.

images.description: Ollama Query node with model selection, prompt, system prompt, sampling, seed, context, and endpoint controls
Ollama Model List node with trigger, endpoint, model-list, and JSON outputs

blocks.body:
## Pass chat history forward

Ollama Chat used the local `/api/chat` endpoint, accepted prior messages as JSON, and returned the updated history alongside the response. Connecting that output into another chat node kept the conversation explicit in the workflow instead of storing it in a hidden global session.
